demos.title: FM arpeggio, ping-pong
demos.description: Held chords arpeggiated into the 8-voice FM synth, shaped by the EQ and bounced left and right by a tempo-synced ping-pong delay.

demos.title: FM chord pad
demos.description: Slow chords on the FM synth with a soft attack, widened by the chorus and washed in reverb.

demos.title: Plucked strings
demos.description: A sixteenth-note line on the Karplus-Strong string, thinned out by Note chance (repeatable seed) and spread with the Haas widener.

demos.title: Granular pad
demos.description: Sea of Grain sprays grains of the bundled pad sample at each note's pitch, with octave grains and a long release into the reverb.

demos.title: Drum bus
demos.description: Drum sequencer into the bundled kit, panned on the mixer, glued by the compressor and roughened with a little bitcrush.

demos.title: Robot drums (vocoder)
demos.description: The vocoder's carrier is an FM chord; its modulator is the drum kit, so the chords speak in the rhythm of the beat.

demos.title: Send to an effects bus
demos.description: A pluck runs dry to the output while Send taps half of it into a reverb and ping-pong delay bus.

demos.title: Modulated bass
demos.description: A step-sequenced saw bass transposed by Capo and Pitch bender; a looping Ramper sweeps the filter and a note-triggered Envelope pumps the gain.
